text:
ops-sre: Heads up — we missed pages for svc-auth around 12:06 UTC, customers hitting 502s. Incident-bot shows delivery failures.
jamal: I'm seeing failed webhook deliveries in the alert-bridge logs, looks like 502 from pager-proxy.
sarah: Can someone dump the recent incident-bot logs? suspect signing/verify or proxy problem.
incident-bot: automated: delivery_failed: endpoint=\"https://pager-proxy.internal/api/v1/push\" status=502 retries=3 id=inc-98321\n
ops-sre: raw error snippet from alert-bridge:
```
ERROR 12:06:18 bridge/notify.go:245 post https://pager-proxy.internal/api/v1/push: net/http: request canceled (client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)
ERROR 12:06:18 bridge/notify.go:260 response status 502
```

ben: I can manually page the oncall while we triage. Mary, can you ack and start TTR timer?
mary-oncall: ACKed, on it. I got a phone SMS. looks like inc-bot attempts failed but manual SMS worked.
jamal: checking proxy metrics — there was a small spike at 12:05 and the proxy returned 502 for ~90s. No clear rc in the pager service.
sarah: did the signing key rotate last night? we rolled key v3 at 03:00 UTC — if proxy strips x-inc-signature we bail.
ops-sre: Good call. I see request headers were truncated in the proxy access logs:
```
12:05:17 POST /api/v1/push 502 - "-" "172.18.0.9" x-forwarded-for=\"...\" x-inc-signature=\"-\"
```
jamal: quick mitigation: flip alert-bridge to fallback route -> direct-sms for svc-auth. Setting now.
ops-sre: Command I ran:
```
./ctl routes update svc-auth --priority=high --fallback=direct-sms
```
ops-sre: route change applied, triggering manual pages.
incident-bot: automated: fallback_triggered for alert=inc-98321 route=direct-sms
mary-oncall: Received manual pages via SMS and phone, triaging customer impact now. Customers report intermittent 502s for ~2 minutes.
ben: I'm restarting the pager-proxy deployment to clear transient state: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/pager-proxy` (k8s restart in progress)
jamal: proxy pods restarted, health checks green. I can see successful POSTs from incident-bot now.
incident-bot: automated: delivery_succeeded endpoint=https://pager-proxy.internal/api/v1/push id=inc-98321
ops-sre: Summary so far — impact: short customer-facing 502s, missed automated pages for ~90s due to proxy returning 502 and stripping signature header. Manual SMS worked as fallback.
sarah: Action items: 1) postmortem with root cause (proxy header strip after key rotation), 2) add alert for consecutive delivery_502s > 3 in 2m window, 3) make alert-bridge tolerant of missing X-Inc-Signature when route is internal->fallback to fallback route automatically.
ben: I'll open a quick ticket for proxy change (preserve original headers) and add a canary test for webhook round-trip.
mary-oncall: I'll draft customer-facing note and hold until postmortem.
ops-sre: Good work. We'll keep this thread updated. Planning a follow-up retro tomorrow 09:30 PT.
